title: Operational Forecast & Staffing Readiness Slate — Q1 Phased Rollout
body:
Purpose:
This doc is a compact operational forecast and staffing-readiness slate that ties roadmap lanes to weekly KPIs and an executable pre-launch checklist for the upcoming Q1 phased rollout. Intended audience: product-ops, eng SRE leads, release-owners, and on-call coordinators.

Quick summary (one-liner):
Provide a lightweight tracker to decide whether to progress each phase of the rollout based on demand forecasts, SLA burn, staff availability, and quality signals.

Context and constraints:
- We are rolling feature set A (server-side batching + new routing policy) to 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 6 weeks.
- Dedicated capacity reservation for the first two weeks of phase 2 is committed (finance: monthly bump approved).
- Key risk: unexpected latency tail under long-sequence prompts; mitigations rely on prefix caching and fallback variants.
- Acceptance gate cadence: weekly signal review every Monday 09:00 PT.

Roadmap lanes & risk surface (short):
- Lane: Serving runtime optimizations (feature A). Owner: Liam Chen. Risk: kernel selection regressions on T4s during burst.
- Lane: Console + rollout tooling (progressive rollout UI + canary weights). Owner: Sofia Martinez. Risk: telemetry sampling mismatch.
- Lane: Billing & capacity (reserved pool + quota enforcement). Owner: Ethan Brooks. Risk: cost meter lag causing under-reporting in first 24h.
- Lane: Customer comms and opt-in UX. Owner: Priya Nair. Risk: confusing messaging -> support load.

Operational forecast (high level numbers for next 6 weeks):
- Expected weekly requests: 1) week1: 120k, 2) week2: 210k, 3) week3: 420k, 4) week4: 600k, 5) week5: 900k, 6) week6: 1.4M
- Expected token throughput (approx): week1: 45M tokens, week6: 520M tokens (assumes average 370 tokens per request during surge).
- Buffer headroom required: 25% GPU spare capacity reserved for spikes (SRE recommendation).

KPI tracker (rolling weekly signals -> accept/hold/rollback thresholds):
- P50 latency (generation): target <= 180ms, yellow >= 180ms, red >= 300ms. Owner: Liam Chen. Measurement: APM + runtime sampling.
- Error rate (5xx + model-fallbacks): target <= 0.5%, yellow 0.5–1.5%, red >1.5%. Owner: Sofia Martinez.
- Token cost per 1k tokens (effective unit cost): target <= $0.90, yellow $0.90–1.30, red >$1.30. Owner: Ethan Brooks.
- Quality regression (eval holdout prompt set): no more than 2% drop in key F1/rouge-like signals measured by PR-validator harness. Owner: Priya Nair.
- Ops load (support tickets related to rollout): target <= 8/week, yellow 9–20, red >20. Owner: Customer Success (listed as collaborator: Sofia).

Readiness checklist (pre-phase gating items) — mark status during Monday review:
- [ ] Telemetry: sampling parity test between staging and prod enabled and verified (owner: Sofia) — acceptance: identical percentiles within ±5% for baseline requests.
- [ ] Capacity: reserved pool scaled and smoke-tested at 1.25x expected peak (owner: Ethan) — acceptance: no OOM or preemption events during 30m soak.
- [ ] Rollout flags: feature flagging and weight control verified via console (owner: Sofia) — acceptance: incremental weight changes applied and reverted with <2min propagation.
- [ ] Fallback policy: model variant fallbacks and region routing validated (owner: Liam) — acceptance: fallback success path exercised in synthetic test harness.
- [ ] Cost telemetry: billing sidecar emits per-route unit cost within 10% of expected (owner: Ethan) — acceptance: first 24h cost estimate matches invoice projection.
- [ ] Support readiness: on-call rotation assigned, escalations documented, and triage runbook linked (owner: Priya) — acceptance: 2 mock incidents executed and validated.
- [ ] Customer comms: release notes + in-console banner drafted and reviewed (owner: Priya) — acceptance: legal sign-off and CS Q&A doc attached.

Gating signals and decision rule (simple policy):
- Green = all KPIs in target and checklist items completed -> proceed to next weight increase.
- Yellow = one KPI in yellow OR one non-critical checklist missing -> hold for one cycle, mitigate, and re-evaluate next Monday.
- Red = any KPI in red OR critical checklist item failed -> rollback to previous stable weight and trigger incident review.

Contingency & surge playbook (short):
- Short-term spike (<15m): throttle non-essential sampling routes, increase batch window (configurable), and push a transient rate limit on low-tier API keys. Owner: Liam.
- Sustained pressure (>1h): shift traffic to Dedicated pool (preconfigured routing), notify billing to prepare for capacity commit, spin up emergency SRE shift. Owner: Ethan + SRE lead.
- Latency tail event: enable smaller batch-size profile and force single-model low-latency variant for affected customers while running regression capture. Owner: Liam.

Staffing rota (recommended for next 6 weeks):
- Primary on-call: Week1–Week6 rotational assignment (Aisha -> Liam -> Ethan -> Sofia -> Priya -> Aisha).
- Dedicated launch day shadow: two extra engineers from serving-runtime for Week2 launch window (Tues midday -> Thurs end). Names to be confirmed: ping SLA channel.
- Support escalation: CS lead (Sofia) + Product-ops (Aisha) on pager during first 72h of each phase increment.

Action items (next 7 days):
- Aisha: coordinate a 30-minute dry run script for rollback and canary weight revert (owner: Aisha). Due: Friday 2025-11-07.
- Liam: complete prefix-cache soak under 1.5x expected tokens and publish results to the ticket PRODOPS-442. Due: Thursday 2025-11-06.
- Ethan: validate billing sidecar and run end-to-end cost estimate for 72-hour window at projected peak. Due: Monday 2025-11-10.
- Priya: finalize customer comms + attach CS FAQ doc to Confluence release page. Due: Monday 2025-11-10.

Open questions / risks to resolve (notes to self):
- How will quantized model variants affect our token-cost signal? Need a small A/B in staging to measure quality vs cost trade-offs. (owner: Liam + Research).
- Do we have legal signoff on retention window for telemetry traces used in cost reconciliation? (owner: Priya -> Legal).
- Is there a hard limit on Dedicated pool burst that requires approval from cloud procurement? (owner: Ethan).

Notes & provenance:
- Drafted after sync 2025-11-03 with eng leads; captures decisions from that meeting and follow-ups.
- This is intentionally light-weight: detailed trackers (per-route spreadsheets) live in linked Confluence and the Jira board for PRODOPS-442.

How to use this doc during Monday review:
- Print the KPI tracker section and annotate current values during signal review. Record color-coded decisions in the Jira ticket and update the rollout weight.
- If any red signal appears, call an immediate incident triage and label the rollout ticket with rollback-required.

Revision history (brief):
- 2025-11-04 (Aisha) initial draft
- 2025-11-10 (Liam) added prefix-cache soak numbers and updated contingency playbook
- 2025-11-18 (Aisha) incorporated billing test requirements and marked as in_review

TODO (low priority):
- Add small visual: 6-week sparkline of expected token throughput (stored in product-ops Canva folder).
- Hook a lightweight metric dashboard (Grafana panel) into the Monday signal email digest.

If you have edits: leave inline comments on Confluence or ping #prodops-roadmap on Slack.
